title: FLOW: A Research Study to See How Semaglutide Works Compared to Placebo in People With Type 2 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease
condition: type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease

criteria.sentence: Male or female, age above or equal to 18 years at the time of signing informed consent. Japan: Male or female, age above or equal to 20 years at the time of signing informed consent
HbA1c less than or equal to 10% (less than or equal to 86 mmol/mol)

rule.unevaluable_reason: Both definitions need UACR (urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio); the synthetic data has no UACR
rule.label: Renal impairment by eGFR and UACR

criteria.sentence: 1. serum creatinine-based eGFR greater than or equal to 50 and less than or equal to 75 mL/min/1.73 m^2 (CKD-EPI) and UACR greater than 300 and less than 5000 mg/g or

rule.unevaluable_reason: Needs UACR, which the synthetic data lacks; part of the renal impairment criterion above
rule.label: eGFR 50-75 and UACR >300 to <5000 mg/g

criteria.sentence: 2. serum creatinine-based eGFR greater than or equal to 25 and less than 50 mL/min/1.73 m^2 (CKD-EPI) and UACR greater than 100 and less than 5000 mg/g

rule.unevaluable_reason: Needs UACR, which the synthetic data lacks; part of the renal impairment criterion above
rule.label: eGFR 25 to <50 and UACR >100 to <5000 mg/g

criteria.sentence: Treatment with maximum labelled or tolerated dose of a renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) blocking agent including an angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor or an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), unless such treatment is contraindicated or not tolerated. Treatment dose must be stable for at least 4 weeks prior to the date of the laboratory assessments used for determination of the inclusion criteria for renal impairment and kept stable until screening

rule.unevaluable_reason: Needs the dose, 4-week dose stability and contraindication status; the synthetic data has none of these
rule.label: On max-tolerated RAAS blocker unless contraindicated

criteria.sentence: Congenital or hereditary kidney diseases including polycystic kidney disease, autoimmune kidney diseases including glomerulonephritis or congenital urinary tract malformations

rule.unevaluable_reason: Cause of kidney disease is not recorded; the data only has a general CKD flag
rule.label: Exclude hereditary, autoimmune or congenital kidney disease

criteria.sentence: Use of any glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist within 30 days prior to screening

rule.unevaluable_reason: 30-day medication window needs dates; the synthetic data has no dates
rule.label: Exclude GLP-1 receptor agonist use in last 30 days

criteria.sentence: Myocardial infarction, stroke, hospitalisation for unstable angina pectoris or transient ischaemic attack within 60 days prior to the day of screening

rule.unevaluable_reason: 60-day event window needs dates; the synthetic data has no dates
rule.label: Exclude MI, stroke, unstable angina or TIA in last 60 days

criteria.sentence: Presently classified as being in New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class IV heart failure

rule.label: Exclude NYHA Class IV heart failure

criteria.sentence: Planned coronary, carotid or peripheral artery revascularisation

rule.unevaluable_reason: Future plans are not in the records
rule.label: Exclude planned revascularisation

criteria.sentence: Current (or within 90 days) chronic or intermittent haemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis

rule.label: Exclude current dialysis (90-day history not checked)

criteria.sentence: Uncontrolled and potentially unstable diabetic retinopathy or maculopathy. Verified by a fundus examination performed within the past 90 days prior to screening or in the period between screening and randomisation. Pharmacological pupil-dilation is a requirement unless using a digital fundus photography camera specified for non-dilated examination

rule.unevaluable_reason: Retinopathy and eye exam results are not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Exclude uncontrolled diabetic retinopathy or maculopathy
